senses.gloss:
विघट् वि-घट् [cf. वि-घट्ट् below], cl. 1. A.
-घटते, -घटितुम्, to become separate, crumble
away, fly apart, burst, disperse; to be broken or
interrupted; to be destroyed: Caus. -घटयति,
-यितुम्, to tear apart, separate, disperse; to remove,
displace.

विघट्ट् वि-घट्ट्, cl. 1. A., 10. P. -घट्टते,
-घट्टयति, -घट्टितुम्, -घट्टयितुम्, to strike
or force asunder, break asunder, burst open, open (a
door &c.); to separate, disperse; to strike, shake,
rub against, touch; to break (an agreement), violate,
betray.

वि-घटन, अम्, n. breaking up, destruction,
ruin, misfortune.

वि-घटिका, f. a particular measure of time, the
sixtieth part of a Ghaṭikā or Gharī, equal to twenty-
four seconds (= पल).

वि-घटित, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, divided, severed;
[cf. वि-घट्टित.]

वि-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck apart, severed,
dispersed, opened, disclosed, untied, undone; struck,
rubbed, touched; excessively shaken, churned; hurt,
offended.

वि-घट्टिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking apart, striking,
touching.

विघन 1. वि-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, cloudless,
destitute of clouds.
—विघनेन्दु (˚न-इन्˚), उस्, m.
a cloudless moon.

विघन 2. वि-घन, अस्, m. (fr. वि-हन्), an
implement for striking, a mallet, hammer; one who
destroys or overpowers.

वि-घनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. slaying, killing; (ई),
m. one who slays, a slayer, destroyer.

वि-घात, अस्, m. destruction, killing; a blow;
opposition, prohibition, prevention, impediment,
obstacle; abandoning.
—विघात-सिद्धि, इस्, f. the
settling or removal of obstacles or impediments.
विघात वि-घात, &c. See col. 1.

वि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, slaying, killing, wounding,
destroying; removing; opposing, impeding, pre-
venting.

वि-घ्न, अस्, m. (occasionally also अम्, n.), obstacle,
impediment, hindrance, obstruction, interruption, pre-
vention, opposition; any difficulty or trouble; the Ca-
ronda or Carissa Carondas.
—विघ्न-कर, अस्, ई,
अम्, causing any obstacle or interruption, opposing,
impeding, obstructing.
—विघ्न-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ,
causing obstacles.
—विघ्न-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing
obstacles, impeding, obstructing; fearful, formidable,
terrible.
—विघ्न-ध्वंस, अस्, m. the removal of
obstacles.
—विघ्न-नायक, अस्, m. ‘obstacle-chief,’
an epithet of Gaṇeśa, (this deity being supposed
capable of causing or removing difficulties and being
therefore worshipped at the commencement of any
[]
undertaking.)
—विघ्न-नाशक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or
what removes obstacles or difficulties; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—विघ्न-नाशन, अम्, n. the
destruction or removal of obstacles; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—विघ्न-प्रतिक्रिया, f. the
counteraction or removal of an impediment.
—वि-
घ्न-राज, अस्, m. ‘obstacle-king,’ epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—विघ्न-लेश, अस्, m. a slight obstacle or impedi-
ment.
—विघ्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having obstacles,
obstructed by difficulties or impediments.
—विघ्न-
विघात, अस्, m. the removal of obstacles.
—विघ्न-
विनायक, अस्, m. ‘obstacle-remover,’ epithet of Ga-
ṇeśa.
—विघ्न-सिद्धि, इस्, f. the settling or removal
of obstacles.
—विघ्न-हन्तृ, ता, m. a remover or
destroyer of obstacles.
—विघ्न-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
removing obstacles; (ई), m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—विघ्नेश or विघ्नेशान or विघ्नेश्वर (˚न-
ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘obstacle-lord,’ epithet of Gaṇeśa.
—वि-
घ्नेश-वाहन, अस्, m. the vehicle of Gaṇeśa, a rat.
—विघ्नेशान-कान्ता (˚न-ईश्˚), f. ‘loved by Ga-
ṇeśa,’ a kind of white Dūrvā grass.
विघ्न वि-घ्न. See col. 1.

विघ्नक (at the end of comps.) = वि-घ्न,
preventing, hindering.

विघ्नय, Nom. P. विघ्नयति, -यितुम्, to im-
pede, check, obstruct.

विघ्नित, अस्, आ, अम्, impeded, stopped, prevented,
obstructed.

विघस वि-घस, अस्, m. (see rt. घस्), the
residue of an oblation of food (offered to the gods,
to the Manes, to a guest, or to a spiritual preceptor);
food in general; (अम्), n. bee's-wax.
—विघसाश
(˚स-आश), अस्, or विघसाशिन्, ई, m. one who eats
the remains of an offering.

विघुष् वि-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घो-
षितुम्, to cry or proclaim aloud; to sound, re-
sound; to fill with noise.

वि-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, cried out, proclaimed
loudly, cried; made to resound, resounding, reso-
nant, vocal.
वि-घुष्य, ind. having proclaimed aloud.

वि-घोषण, अम्, n. the act of proclaiming aloud,
proclamation, crying.

विघूर्ण् वि-घूर्ण्, cl. 1. P. A. -घूर्णति, -ते,
-घूर्णितुम्, to roll about, whirl about, shake about,
be agitated; to roll (the eyes).

वि-घूर्णत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, rolling about, shaking;
rolling (the eyes).

वि-घूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled or shaken about;
rolled (as the eyes); rolling, shaking.

विघृत वि-घृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. destitute
of moisture.

विघृष्ट वि-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively
rubbed or ground; rubbed; sore.

विघ्रा वि-घ्रा, cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्,
to smell or scent out, find out by smelling, perceive,
discover; to smell at, smell.
